entry.title: Notes on Post-training
entry.content:
This page checks syntax highlighting and nested headings. The snippets are examples only.

Setup

A post-training note usually starts with the command used to launch the job.

Environment

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -U pip
pip install torch transformers

Config

{
  "model": "placeholder-lm",
  "lr": 2e-5,
  "max_steps": 1000
}

Training

The following snippet is only here to confirm Python highlighting.

Policy update

def advantage(rewards, values, gamma=0.99):
    returns = []
    g = 0.0
    for r, v in zip(reversed(rewards), reversed(values)):
        g = r + gamma * g
        returns.append(g)
    returns.reverse()
    return [g - v for g, v in zip(returns, values)]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(advantage([1.0, 0.0, 1.0], [0.3, 0.2, 0.4]))

Check

If the blocks above keep their language colors in both light and dark mode, this page has done its job.

entry.title: Some Mathematical Notes
entry.content:
This page checks that MathJax is working. The statements below are standard facts, not a real paper.

Inline math

The Gaussian integral is \(\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\, dx = \sqrt{\pi}\). For a vector \(x \in \mathbb{R}^n\), write \(\|x\|_2 = \sqrt{x^\top x}\).

Display math

The Cauchy–Schwarz inequality says

\[\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \le \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right).\]

An expectation form of the same idea is

\begin{equation} \label{eq:expectation} \bigl(\mathbb{E}[XY]\bigr)^2 \le \mathbb{E}[X^2]\,\mathbb{E}[Y^2]. \end{equation}

Reference

If numbered equations work, \eqref{eq:expectation} should resolve to the display above.
